entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A renowned initiate, master of the double khopesh and a dependable leader among her crop; she later became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Samut's close friend among the initiates.

events.summary: Samut is a leader among her crop, highly dependable in battle and seeming to be everywhere at once.
events.quote: She was a leader among her crop, and was highly dependable during battle.

relations.note: Close friends, unstoppable among the initiates.
relations.quote: She and her close friend Djeru were unstoppable among the initiates.
